meta.name: cyber
meta.description: Cyber / neural portfolio look extracted from current profileDef: dark navy surfaces, cyan-blue-violet brand gradients, glass navigation, compact Inter typography, JetBrains Mono tech tags, and a Three.js/R3F neural particle field with bloom.

primary.role: Primary brand blue for CTAs, links, and neural mid-tones

secondary.role: Violet secondary for gradient terminals, depth accents, and bloom highlights

accent.role: Cyan accent for borders, focus rings, hover glow, and neural particle highlights

neutral.usage: Lightest (#F1F5F9) is primary text; mid slate (#94A3B8/#64748B) for secondary/muted; dark navy stack for surfaces and canvas background (#050816)

color.contrast_strategy: high contrast light text on deep navy with layered cyan/blue/violet glow accents; secondary copy uses slate mid-tones

typography.font_style_notes: Compact geometric sans (Inter) for UI/headings; JetBrains Mono reserved for tech tags and code; root 16px with clamped hero ~2–2.65rem — never giant body scale

spacing.section_rhythm: Sections use ~60px vertical padding (48px tablet / 40px mobile) with 40px internal gaps; hero fills viewport minus 72px nav offset

layout.grid_system: CSS flex + CSS grid hybrid; projects 2-col / skills certs 3-col collapsing to 1
layout.columns: 2–3 content columns with single-column mobile stack
layout.alignment_tendency: centered sections with left-aligned text on desktop hero/about; mobile centers

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px slate borders with cyan-strong (#22D3EE @ 28%) on hover/focus; hairline cyan on glass nav
shape.divider_style: 1px rgba(148,163,184,0.14) hairlines; accent 3px left border on experience details; gradient top inset on cards

elevation.shadow_style: soft diffused with cyan glow accents
elevation.depth_cues: layered navy surfaces + glass blur + cyan glow shadows + R3F bloom

iconography.style: flat SVG social/menu icons with muted-to-full opacity hover
iconography.preferred_set: custom SVG assets (social, menu, location) plus Font Awesome GitHub glyph on project cards

motion.entrance_pattern: subtle translateY/X on hover rather than entrance choreography; floating tech tags use infinite ease-in-out float
motion.philosophy: minimal functional micro-motion with ambient neural field motion behind content

components.button_style: Pill CTAs with cyan→blue gradient fill, white label, soft cyan glow + translateY(-2px) on hover; secondary ghost pills with slate border turning cyan
components.input_style: Elevated surface (#1A2332), 10px radius, slate border; focus cyan border + 3px rgba(34,211,238,0.12) ring
components.card_style: Surface #111827, 16px radius, shadow-card, 1px border; optional 3px brand-gradient top inset; hover lift -4px + border-strong + glow
components.navigation_pattern: Fixed glass top bar (64px) with blur, logo left, links center-right, gradient Connect pill; mobile slide-in drawer
components.modal_style: none present — overlays use certificate hover wash instead
components.list_style: Vertical stacked experience cards with accent left rail; skill bars as gradient pills
components.component_notes: Tech tags use mono font + elevated surface; certificate cards use primary-blue hover overlay; about photo framed by animated brand-gradient border

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Neural network / cyber command deck floating over deep space navy
aesthetic.era_influence: 2020s neo-cyber UI with restrained neon (not 80s synthwave kitsch)

visual_language.whitespace_usage: comfortable breathing room with dense card content
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy ambient 3D field behind lighter glass/card UI chrome
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero portrait + gradient name, then section title gradients guide scroll
visual_language.texture_usage: soft radial color washes + optional low-opacity scanline/grid CSS texture; R3F particles for generative texture

composition.hierarchy_method: typographic hierarchy + gradient color weight on titles/CTAs
composition.balance_type: asymmetric hero (photo left / copy right) with centered section shells
composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom scroll with left-to-right hero reading path
composition.grouping_strategy: cards and pill tags cluster related tech/projects; experience items as stacked modules
composition.negative_space_role: dark navy negative space frames glowing UI; radial washes prevent flat voids

imagery.photo_treatment: circular portrait with brand-gradient ring pulse; about photo in animated gradient frame
imagery.illustration_style: abstract 3D neural geometry (icosahedron edges, splines, torus knot in HeroScene)
imagery.graphic_elements: gradient text fills, pill badges, skill bars, card top accent lines, floating tech labels
imagery.pattern_usage: subtle CSS scanline/grid under hero; radial multi-stop body washes
imagery.image_shape: circle for hero portrait; rounded 12–16px for project/certificate imagery

interaction_feel.feedback_style: glow + border color shift + small lift
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: translateY(-2/-4px), border-strong cyan, shadow-glow, accent text color
interaction_feel.loading_style: instant paint with ambient R3F scene already looping
interaction_feel.microinteraction_density: moderate — hover lifts on cards/tags/CTAs, floating tags, ring pulse

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: professional-technical with friendly first-person hero copy
brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative (Get in touch / View projects / Connect)
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: calm corrective (form validation would use semantic error red if added)

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS radial gradients and glass if WebGL unavailable; keep static surfaces

background_effects.description: Fixed full-viewport neural field: additive particles, Catmull-Rom splines with traveling dots, rotating icosahedron wireframe, soft ambient glow sphere, dark #050816 clear color
background_effects.technology: React Three Fiber + Three.js + EffectComposer Bloom

params.speed: slow ambient (particles ~0.015 rad/s yaw; spline travelers 0.08–0.14)

particle_systems.description: Spherical shell of 800 additive points colored along cyan→blue→violet lerp; slow rotation; paired with spline curves acting as neural pathways

params.movement_pattern: rigid group rotation + subtle pitch sine; spline dots travel along curves

3d_elements.description: Background neural scene with central icosahedron edges + optional HeroScene torus knot (if mounted); fixed Canvas pointer-events none

params.renderer: WebGLRenderer via R3F Canvas, dpr [1,1.5], antialias, alpha false
params.lighting: unlit meshBasic/lineBasic in ThreeBackground; HeroScene uses ambient + dual directional with violet fill
params.materials: additive pointsMaterial, lineBasicMaterial, meshBasicMaterial ambient glow
params.geometry: buffer particles, CatmullRomCurve3 lines, Icosahedron EdgesGeometry, sphere glow

shader_effects.description: No custom GLSL; bloom is postprocessing pass only

text_effects.description: Section titles and hero name use CSS background-clip text with cyan→blue (and full brand) gradients

cursor_effects.description: No custom cursor, trail, or spotlight

image_effects.description: Standard cover images with opacity transition; certificate blue wash overlay on hover — no distortion shaders

params.shadow_type: soft drop + cyan glow on CTA hover

canvas_drawings.description: No Canvas 2D drawings; WebGL only via R3F

svg_animations.description: Static SVG assets for icons/menu; no SMIL or path-draw animations

visual_effects.composite_notes: Primary spectacle is the fixed R3F neural background (800 additive particles, 12 splines, bloom intensity 0.6) behind a glass navbar and surface cards. CSS adds radial washes, optional low-opacity scanline/grid (0.03–0.06), gradient-clipped titles, and cyan glow hovers. Keep particle count ≤800. Align neuralColor hexes to tokens #22D3EE / #3B82F6 / #7C3AED. Compact type only — root 16px, hero clamp ≤2.65rem.
